payload.name: Name-Liking
payload.fact: Name-Liking is an implicit measure of global self-esteem based on the mere-ownership effect.

provenance.title: “How much do you like your name?” An implicit measure of global self-esteem
provenance.quote_or_locus: We introduce a single-item implicit measure of global self-esteem. The measure is based on the mere-ownership effect and asks participants to indicate how much they like their name
